title: Quasi-compact complement of finitely presented module support
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative ring and $M$ a $B$-module admitting an exact sequence $B^u\to B^v\to M\to0$ for finite integers $u,v\ge0$ (a finitely presented module). In $\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], put $\operatorname{Supp}_B(M)=\{\mathfrak p: M_{\mathfrak p}\ne0\}$, where $M_{\mathfrak p}$ consists of fractions $m/s$ for $s\notin\mathfrak p$, with the usual equality after multiplication by another element outside $\mathfrak p$. Then $\operatorname{Supp}_B(M)$ is closed and its complement is quasi-compact, meaning every cover of the complement by open subsets has a finite subcover.

proof.text: Apply the intermediate maximal-minor support theorem to obtain a finitely generated ideal I with Module.support B M = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus I.
The support is closed by Mathlib Module.isClosed_support, since finite presentation implies finite generation.
Rewrite the complement using the ideal equality and apply PrimeSpectrum.isCompact_isOpen_iff_ideal to the finitely generated ideal I.
